title: The best stretch for wrist pain you're not doing (credit to Uncle Nic)
summary: He demonstrates a band wrist stretch learned from strongman YouTuber Uncle Nic: a band anchored to a post pulls the wrist back while you point the elbow up and walk forward. It relieved his wrist pain, and he uses it between front squat sets to improve front-rack mobility.

claims.claim: Wrist pain is common in lifters who press a lot (bench, overhead press) and especially with front squats, and can become chronic.
He learned this wrist stretch from strongman YouTuber Uncle Nic.

Band wrist stretch: anchor a band to a solid post, wrap it around the hand and wrist and grab it, rotate to point the elbow at the ceiling, then walk forward until tension is maximal so the wrist is pulled backward.
During the stretch, hold the wrist position against the band without collapsing or twisting at the wrist, letting it be stretched.
He does the stretch between front squat sets; repeated through the session it improves front-rack mobility so working sets feel comfortable.
This stretch helped him get rid of his own wrist pain.

exercises.name: Band wrist stretch (Uncle Nic)
cues: don't twist or give at the wrist
exercises.why: relieves wrist pain, improves front-rack mobility
